definitions.explanation: Refers to beef or other meat with fine streaks of fat running through it, resembling frost. Highly prized in Japanese cuisine for its tenderness and flavor.
A pattern or appearance resembling frost, used to describe textiles, ceramics, or other surfaces with a speckled white-on-dark pattern.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{霜降|しもふ}り⟦{和牛|わぎゅう}→和牛：27668_wagyuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{柔|やわ}らかい→柔らかい：01096_yawarakai⟧。
examples.english: This marbled wagyu beef is very tender.

examples.japanese: {霜降|しもふ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦{高級|こうきゅう}→高級：08644_koukyuu⟧な⟦{牛肉|ぎゅうにく}→牛肉：02874_gyuuniku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦すき{焼|や}き→すき焼き：10368_sukiyaki⟧にした。
examples.english: We made sukiyaki with high-grade marbled beef.

examples.japanese: {霜降|しもふ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{着物|きもの}→着物：01309_kimono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}た→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
examples.english: She wore a kimono with a frost pattern.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{皿|さら}→皿：00883_sara⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{霜降|しもふ}り⟦{模様|もよう}→模様：03635_moyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: This plate has a beautiful frosted pattern.

examples.japanese: ⟦{白|しろ}→白：13854_shiro⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{灰色|はいいろ}→灰色：04303_haiiro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{霜降|しもふ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生地|きじ}→生地：02631_kiji⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦コート→コート：01358_kooto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{仕立|した}てた→仕立てる：09525_shitateru⟧。
examples.english: The coat was tailored from a white and gray heathered fabric.

notes: When referring to meat, {霜降|しもふ}り describes the fine white fat marbling that runs through red meat, creating a pattern that looks like frost (⟦{霜|しも}→霜：03202_shimo⟧). This marbling is a key quality indicator for Japanese beef, especially ⟦{和牛|わぎゅう}→和牛：27668_wagyuu⟧. The word comes from ⟦{霜|しも}→霜：03202_shimo⟧ (frost) + {降|ふ}り (falling). In the textile sense, it refers to a heathered or speckled pattern. Common collocations include {霜降|しもふ}り⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧ (marbled meat) and {霜降|しもふ}り⟦{和牛|わぎゅう}→和牛：27668_wagyuu⟧ (marbled wagyu).
